Combining the brand's look with local conventions
Headings: Noto Sans JP 700, 64-80px; Body: Noto Sans JP 500, 32-40px; Mono: monospace for source chips; Line-height: 1.5 or higher for all Japanese text

brief.palette: Background #f5efe3, Surface #fffcf5, Text #1c1a17, Muted #655e53, Primary #c5361d, Accent #1e3b63
brief.typography: Headings: Noto Sans JP 700, 64-80px; Body: Noto Sans JP 500, 32-40px; Mono: monospace for source chips; Line-height: 1.5 or higher for all Japanese text
brief.motion: Fades and short slides, 300-500ms duration, ease-out easing, staggered reveals for supporting points and chips
brief.layout: 1920x1080 canvas with generous margins; logo fixed in corner on all scenes; Scene 1: Headline + 2-3 points + source chips; Scene 2: Supporting proof points + source chips; Scene 3: Source chips and partner logos; Scene 4: Logo, CTA button, and URL centered
notes: Set all Japanese text in Noto Sans JP with weight 700 for headlines and 500 for body, ensuring no word breaks across lines.
Include source chips for every supporting point, displaying source names, numbers, or certifications in monospace font.
Maintain calm, precise motion with 300-500ms fades and slides; avoid bouncing, slang, or exaggerated effects.
Keep the logo visible in a corner on every scene and end the video on the logo, call-to-action button, and URL.
Use the brand's own colors exclusively: #f5efe3 background, #fffcf5 surface, #1c1a17 text, #655e53 muted, #c5361d primary, #1e3b63 accent.
Ensure high information density by including headline plus two or three short supporting points per scene, each with a small source chip.

reasons.local: セキュリティ、データ保存場所、SLAに関する言及が完全に欠落しており、日本企業の情報システム部門として承認できません。
reasons.en: Complete lack of mention regarding security, data location, and SLAs, which is unacceptable for a Japanese enterprise IT department.

reasons.local: 価格が「無料」とのみ記載され、円建ての明確な料金体系や、APIキー利用時のコスト構造が示されていません。
reasons.en: Pricing is only listed as 'free', without a clear yen-denominated pricing structure or cost breakdown for API key usage.

reasons.local: 日本語の自然さは概ね保たれていますが、ハッカソンプロジェクトであるという背景（f02, f03）が隠されており、エンタープライズ向けの信頼性に欠けます。
reasons.en: While the Japanese is generally natural, the fact that it is a hackathon project (f02, f03) is hidden, which undermines trust for enterprise buyers.
